notes.title: Changelog v1.0.2
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug during Level 1 that allowed players to breach out of the map.
- Fixed a bug during Level 3 that disabled players from progressing during the beginning of the level when picking up the jetpack.
- Changed the amount of lives for the player, cross-level, to 3.
- 2 new easter eggs added.
- Starting works on fixing achievement integration.
